purpose: Design document for the start-design orchestrator skill that creates design documents from requirements, covering phases, matching with existing implementations, review and completion.
summary: Overview: flow from upstream design through matching existing patterns to detailed design and review
Flowchart of preparation and Phases 1 to 6 with redesign loop
Preparation steps: requirement identification, feature, output directory, differential check, full-new judgment, mode, state table, normative docs
Phase 1 input collection of project rules via query-db-rules
Phase 2 upstream design from requirements only with approvals and ID numbering
Phase 3 matching with existing implementations, redesign, and overlap check with existing specs deciding the type
Phases 4 and 5 detailed design and consistency check with traceability table
Phase 6 self review, review skill and user approval, plus handling of needs missing from requirements
Completion steps and design principles: build from requirements, reuse existing components, full coverage, What/How boundary
tasks: Modifying the start-design skill or its workflow
Judging differential, additive or full-new design type
Handling design needs not covered by requirements
